scripts.vercel-build: test -f .env.production && test -f build/web/index.html && test -f build/web/assets/.env.production || (echo 'Missing production build artifacts or .env.production bundle. Run flutter build web --release first.' && exit 1)
scripts.deploy:prod: flutter build web --release --no-tree-shake-icons && vercel build --prod && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
